options.content: Optimizer objective J, weighted-term contribution fractions (CE, book quality, inventory zone), final weighted components plus objective total, and timing.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT e.ts AS "time", stage AS metric,
       CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','objective',stage,'value'], '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','objective',stage,'value'], ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END AS value
FROM mm_events e
CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(ARRAY['initial','final','best']) AS stage
WHERE e.topic LIKE 'strategy:diagnostics:%'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.actor_id = ANY(ARRAY[${actor_id:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
  AND e.payload #>> ARRAY['optimizer','objective',stage,'value'] IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 1

SELECT e.ts AS "time", kv.key AS metric, CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(kv.value, '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(kv.value, ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END AS value
FROM mm_events e
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each_text(
  COALESCE(
    e.payload #> ARRAY['optimizer','objective','contribution_fractions'],
    e.payload #> ARRAY['optimizer','objective','final','contribution_fractions'],
    '{}'::jsonb
  )
) AS kv
WHERE e.topic LIKE 'strategy:diagnostics:%'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.actor_id = ANY(ARRAY[${actor_id:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
  AND kv.key IN ('risk_adjusted_return', 'validity_penalty', 'viability_penalty', 'global_validity_penalty', 'global_viability_penalty')
ORDER BY 1

SELECT e.ts AS "time", kv.key AS metric,
       CASE WHEN kv.key LIKE '%_sec' THEN (CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(kv.value, '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(kv.value, ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END) * 1000.0 ELSE (CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(kv.value, '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(kv.value, ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END) END AS value
FROM mm_events e
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each_text(COALESCE(e.payload #> ARRAY['optimizer','timing'], '{}'::jsonb)) AS kv
WHERE e.topic LIKE 'strategy:diagnostics:%'
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.actor_id = ANY(ARRAY[${actor_id:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
  AND trim(kv.value) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
ORDER BY 1

list.definition:
SELECT exchange
FROM (
  SELECT exchange, max(ts) AS latest_ts
  FROM (
  SELECT exchange, ts
  FROM mm_events
  WHERE exchange IS NOT NULL
    AND exchange <> ''
    AND event_type IN ('StrategyDecision', 'ControllerDiagnostics', 'JointTargetBook')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT gates.key AS exchange, e.ts
  FROM mm_events e
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(
    COALESCE(e.payload #> ARRAY['execution_gates','venue_gates'], '{}'::jsonb)
  ) AS gates(key, value)
  WHERE e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
    AND gates.key IS NOT NULL
    AND gates.key <> ''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT payload #>> ARRAY['local_market','exchange'] AS exchange, ts
  FROM mm_events
  WHERE event_type = 'JointStrategyFrame'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT payload #>> ARRAY['global_market','exchange'] AS exchange, ts
  FROM mm_events
  WHERE event_type = 'JointStrategyFrame'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT exchange, ts
  FROM mm_events
  WHERE event_type = 'MarketEvent'
    AND exchange IS NOT NULL
    AND exchange <> ''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT exchange, ts
  FROM mm_events
  WHERE event_type IN ('PrivateStateSnapshot', 'VenueLedgerSnapshot')
    AND exchange IS NOT NULL
    AND exchange <> ''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT COALESCE(
      exchange,
      payload->>'exchange',
      substring(topic from '^private:state:([^:]+):snapshot$'),
      substring(topic from '^ledger:snapshot:([^:]+)$')
    ) AS exchange,
    ts
  FROM mm_events
  WHERE event_type IN ('PrivateStateSnapshot', 'VenueLedgerSnapshot')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT substring(topic from '^private:state:([^:]+):errors$') AS exchange, ts
  FROM mm_events
  WHERE topic LIKE 'private:state:%:errors'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT exchange, ts
  FROM mm_market_facts
  WHERE exchange IS NOT NULL AND exchange <> ''
  ) sources
  WHERE exchange IS NOT NULL AND exchange <> ''
  GROUP BY exchange
) ranked
ORDER BY latest_ts DESC

SELECT interval_ms
FROM (
  SELECT interval_ms, max(latest_ts) AS latest_ts
  FROM (
    SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(payload->>'interval_ms', ''), substring(topic from ':([0-9]+)$')) AS interval_ms, ts AS latest_ts
    FROM mm_events
    WHERE COALESCE(NULLIF(payload->>'interval_ms', ''), substring(topic from ':([0-9]+)$')) IS NOT NULL
      AND COALESCE(NULLIF(payload->>'interval_ms', ''), substring(topic from ':([0-9]+)$')) <> ''
    UNION ALL
    SELECT interval_ms::text AS interval_ms, ts AS latest_ts
    FROM mm_market_facts
    WHERE interval_ms IS NOT NULL
  ) sources
  GROUP BY interval_ms
) ranked
ORDER BY latest_ts DESC
